card.title: Credit
card.hint: How much more this customer can buy on installments. Exposure is the unpaid principal of the open contracts.
card.blockedHint: A blocked customer can't get an exception.
card.scoreBelow: Below the minimum: an installment sale needs an approved exception.

limit.title: Set the credit limit
limit.hint: The limit is what the server checks when an installment sale is made. A limit below what the customer already owes is allowed: they just can't take more.
limit.suggestedHint: Suggested from monthly income × the shop's multiple: {amount}
limit.noSuggestion: No suggestion: the monthly income or the multiple in the settings is empty.
limit.reasonHint: Required when the limit goes up. It stays in the audit log.

request.title: Request a credit exception
request.hint: Ask a manager to let this customer buy above their available credit, below the minimum score or while on watch. Valid for {hours} hours and for one contract.

exceptions.title: Credit exceptions
exceptions.description: Requests to sell on installments above the limit, below the minimum score or to a customer on watch.
exceptions.emptyHint: No credit exception matches this filter.
exceptions.approveHint: {name} will be able to sell {amount} on installments to this customer for 24 hours, for one contract.
exceptions.rejectHint: Say why: the requester will see it.
exceptions.noteRequired: A note is required to reject.
exceptions.cancelHint: The request is withdrawn and can't be approved any more.

errors.permission: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.module: Customers aren't part of this shop's plan.
errors.validation: Check the fields and try again.
errors.notFound: This customer or request wasn't found.
errors.reasonRequired: Write a reason of at least 3 letters.
errors.limitExceeded: The amount is above the customer's available credit.
errors.scoreTooLow: The customer's score is below the shop's minimum.
errors.approvalInvalid: The exception can't be used: it isn't approved, was used, expired, or is for a smaller amount.
errors.blocked: This customer is blocked or archived.
errors.notPending: This request was already decided or cancelled.
errors.notNeeded: The customer can buy this amount without an exception.
errors.noteRequired: A note is required to reject.
errors.self: You can't decide your own request.
errors.expired: The subscription has expired: you can read but not change anything.
